bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the commissioner of health for Youth and AIDS Projects.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; YOUTH AND AIDS PROJECTS.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to the University of Minnesota Foundation for the Youth and AIDS Projects. The grant must be used to develop, implement, and evaluate status-neutral strategies among Black males 15 to 34 years of age at high risk for HIV through nonmedical case management and support services.
